name: FTP
author: djware
description: Starts an FTP server on the device. Run again to stop it. Automatically times out after 5 minutes of inactivity. Optionally modify the script to set a root password.

name: FTP Enable
author: djware
description: Enables FTP at every boot by mounting /mnt/SDCARD. Run once to enable persistent FTP access (user: root, pass: root). Run again to disable the boot entry.

name: Telnetd
author: djware
description: Installs a static telnetd binary and adds it to rc.local so the device is accessible via Telnet on port 23 at every boot. Sets root credentials to user: root, pass: root. Only needs to be run once.

name: Random Game
author: djware
description: Picks a random emulator and a matching ROM from your SDCARD and launches it. Configurable base directories for Roms and Emus via script edit.

name: Max CPU
author: djware
description: Forces the device into Performance CPU governor mode and keeps it there even after resets or FN button presses. LEDs turn green on success.

name: Reboot
author: djware
description: A simple app to restart the TrimUI Smart Pro quickly and cleanly from within the menu.

name: Mac Update
author: djware
description: Sets the device Wi-Fi MAC address to a static value to prevent connectivity issues across reboots. Not required on firmware 1.0.4 hotfix 20240414 or later.

name: RainbowLEDs
author: djware
description: Cycles the joystick and middle LEDs through a full rainbow of colors in a continuous loop. Run the app again to stop the effect.

name: LED Temp
author: djware
description: Colors the LEDs to indicate CPU temperature in real time: green (<40C) through red (>70C). Run the app again to stop the effect.

name: LED Batt
author: djware
description: Colors the LEDs to indicate remaining battery percentage in real time: green (100-90%) through red (<20%). Run the app again to stop the effect.

name: UDISK
author: djware
description: Formats and unlocks the internal UDISK partition as FAT32, exposing ~6 GB of on-device storage for apps, emulators, and ROMs. Also replaces the stock usb_storage app to allow simultaneous SDCARD and UDISK USB mounting. USE AT YOUR OWN RISK — formats UDISK partition. Only needs to be run once.

name: Bootlogo Updater
author: djware
description: Replaces the startup boot image with a custom BMP file. Place a logo.bmp (max 1280x720, under 6 MB) on the root of SDCARD or UDISK and run this app to apply it.
